video_title: The Kawhi Leonard Experience Set the Clippers Back 10 YEARS

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's departure and the Clippers' massive punishment

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Speaking of some that had a target on their back, Kawhi Leonard. He dodged that and he is going to Toronto, that trade went through. He got an extension, 2 for 115. So just curious what you think about what happened with the Clippers and all that and him only really getting a 700,000 dollar fine, Uncle Dennis is banned from the NBA for five years, but Kawhi doesn't have to sit in the shit really with the Clippers anymore and he is on the Raptors who have a pretty decent team.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Huge Kawhi Leonard fan, but that whole Kawhi experience, if you bring Paul George in the mix, set that franchise back 10 years for sure, but 10 if you really think about it. They lose first-round picks, got people suspended, Lawrence Frank is a snitch, just a lot of different shit going on over there, but Kawhi came out unscathed.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Timberwolves' front office punishment in 2000
quotes.excerpt: The last person to kind of do this at that level that a team got punished for was in 2000 with the Timberwolves.
quotes.quote: The last person to kind of do this at that level that a team got punished for was in 2000 with the Timberwolves. Joe Smith, yeah, and Glen Taylor got banned, but this obviously with inflation and everything, this was the biggest one.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Contract negotiations and the Knicks' future
quotes.excerpt: Do you think this contract negotiation stuff is going to affect the Knicks in any way?
quotes.quote: Knicks, obviously one of the most historic finals runs the last handful of years, haven't won a title in over 50 years. Brought back the team, mostly minus Mitchell Robinson, he is with Boston now, but there is this looming discussion with Karl-Anthony Towns that they tabled the extension talks for him. It is reported he got 4 and 200 offered to him, but he can make 4 and 276. So a difference of 76 million dollars there. Josh Hart is another player that is up after this year, they got a team option on him so they could stretch that out. Do you think this contract negotiation stuff is going to affect the Knicks in any way?

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' championship expectations and the difficulty of repeating
quotes.excerpt: In professional sports the hardest thing to do is repeat.
quotes.quote: I don't think the negotiations will help, but I think in professional sports the hardest thing to do is repeat because there is so much more distractions. Obviously, Nick fans are going to be expecting what they always expect, but they actually finally got it, which was a championship. So now it is championship or bust. Really interesting to see, I mean, Jalen Brunson set the bar with taking less. Now is Kat going to do the same? It looks like Hart will have to do the same too. How much do players sacrifice financial gain to keep something good together?

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's extension and the Warriors' future
quotes.excerpt: I am just curious about the forecast of someone of the stature of Stephen Curry.
quotes.quote: So the Warriors and just kind of Steph's legacy at large. Steph just signed a two-year extension, took a little haircut, about 20 million less than he could have got to give the team some flexibility. But Jemsky, do you see his deal? Made over 100 million dollars. So if you just look at not this upcoming season but the following season, you got people like Jimmy Butler and Draymond Green coming off the books, poor Ivica Zubac, he is someone that is hurt again and they don't know where he is right now. I am just curious about the forecast of someone of the stature of Stephen Curry and how you maximize his time window to potentially get a fifth title.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's commitment to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Steph is going to be on that Kobe, ride the ship till it sinks type situation.
quotes.quote: I feel like Steph is not going nowhere. I think Steph is going to be on that Kobe, ride the ship till it sinks type situation, extension where he took less money to hopefully give the team some flexibility. I like Jaksel, killer, big kid, not afraid of the moment, a shit talker. One of those kids that stayed in college, I think he is 23 or 24 now as a rookie, so he is ready to go. I really like him, but everything else, I want to know what is going on with Ivica Zubac, I don't really care, but I think the fans want to know what is going on with Ivica Zubac because when he is healthy, he is a talent.
